answer: Require every identity to lock a refundable bond that is slashed when peers prove sybil behavior, so each clone costs real capital instead of being free timber for a farm to harvest. The failure mode is bond pooling, where one rich operator funds thousands of copies and treats the odd forfeiture as a cost of business. The check is to trace bond funding sources and flag clusters that echo the same wallet, then slash the whole cluster when any member is caught, keeping the network's pulse honest by making fraud expensive at scale.
